# BoostCart

> BoostCart is an e-commerce SEO agency for Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Magento and headless stores. One team handles technical SEO, category and product pages, content, links and revenue-tied reporting.

Homepage: https://boostcart.agency/
Ecommerce technical SEO service: https://boostcart.agency/services/technical-seo
Category and product page service: https://boostcart.agency/services/category-product-pages
Content and buying guides service: https://boostcart.agency/services/content
Link building service: https://boostcart.agency/services/link-building
Conversion-focused SEO service: https://boostcart.agency/services/conversion-seo
Reporting service: https://boostcart.agency/services/reporting

## What we do
- Technical SEO: crawl, speed, indexation and structured data fixes.
- Category and product page optimization.
- Content and buying guides.
- Link building and digital PR.
- Conversion-focused SEO.
- Reporting tied to organic revenue.

## Platforms
Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Magento and headless storefronts.

## Industries
Fashion and apparel, beauty and skincare, health and supplements, home and furniture, electronics and gadgets, jewelry and accessories, food and beverage, sports and outdoors, pet supplies, baby and kids.

## How we work
Audit, keyword mapping, roadmap, technical fixes, category and product pages, buying guides, authority and links, then monthly reporting and iteration.

## Contact
Free SEO audit and calls are booked through the website.
